verdicts.reason: A: the steps are out of order (1, 3, 2, 4). Step 4 is smaller and indented off the shared left edge. The CTA is shrunk and pushed up beside the logo, where it competes with the brand. The jar is oversized and dominates the right half. B is worse: steps 2–4 are scattered down the far-left edge at a tiny, unreadable size, and their badge numbers look wrong. Step 1 is cut off from the rest of the list and sits at the bottom next to the CTA. The headline is huge while the list falls apart, so the reading order is lost.
